from pathlib import Path


SOURCE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'api' / 'admin_scheduler_resync.py'
TEXT = SOURCE.read_text(encoding='utf-8')


def test_global_normalizer_is_imported():
    assert 'from core.system_type_utils import normalize_system_type' in TEXT


def test_dry_run_normalizes_before_softrestaurant_branch():
    start = TEXT.index('async def _ejecutar_dry_run(')
    end = TEXT.index('async def _ejecutar_sync_real(', start)
    section = TEXT[start:end]
    assert 'sistema_normalizado = normalize_system_type(sistema_raw)' in section
    assert "if sistema == 'SOFTRESTAURANT'" in section
    assert "query_source = 'SOFTRESTAURANT_REPORTE_TURNOS'" in section
    assert "'backend_contract_version': 'softrestaurant-turnos-v2'" in section
    assert "'system_type_raw': sistema_raw" in section
    assert "'system_type_normalized': sistema_normalizado" in section


def test_real_uses_same_normalized_system_type():
    start = TEXT.index('async def _ejecutar_sync_real(')
    end = TEXT.index('@router.get("/resync/history")', start)
    section = TEXT[start:end]
    assert 'sistema_normalizado = normalize_system_type(sistema_raw)' in section
    assert "if sistema == 'SOFTRESTAURANT'" in section
